content: Tiweṣṣa zi jjihet jjar nnek
“Tina i iǧan d lfarayiḍ nni d asen ɣa tessiwḍed.
Mařa tesɣid ismeɣ d Aɛibrani, xenni netta ad ac isexxar setta n iseggʷusa, maca deg useggʷas wiss sebɛa ad iffeɣ d aḥurri baṭeř.
Mařa yudef weḥḥdes, weḥḥdes i ɣa iffeɣ, mařa ɣares tamɣart, ad iffeɣ netta d temɣart nnes.
Mařa sidis iwca as tamɣart uca nettat tejja as-dd iḥenjiren d tḥenjirin, xenni tamɣart d tarwa nnes ad iřin n sidis, u xenni netta ad iffeɣ s iman nnes.
Maca mařa ismeɣ inna nican: ‘Necc xseɣ sidi inu d temɣart inu d tarwa inu, war xseɣ ad ffɣeɣ d aḥurri!’,
řexdenni sidis ad t issbedd zzat i AREBBI. Ad t yawi ɣar tewwart niɣ ɣar tefřawt ɣar uɣezdis n tewwart uca sidis ad as issnuqqeb amejjun nnes s yict n tsineft uca netta ad as isexxar i řebda.
Mařa izzenz ḥed yeǧis d tayya, war itteffiɣ am muxas tteffɣen isemɣan.
Mařa war teɛjib i tiṭṭawin n sidis u netta tuɣa ixḍeb i-tt, ad tt yejj ad tᵉttwafdi. War izemmar ad tt izzenz i yijj n řgens n barra minzi netta iɣdar zzayes s min igga.
Mařa ixḍeb i-tt i mmis, ad kides yegg ɛlaḥsab lfariḍa zi jjhet n yeǧis.
Mařa iksi tamɣart nneɣni i yixef nnes, war ineqqeṣ řɛuč n weysum nnes, niɣ arruḍ nnes, niɣ řɛacart nnes.
Mařa netta war d as iggi třata-ya, xenni nettat ad teffeɣ baṭeř, břa řexraṣ.”
“Wenni i ɣa iwten ḥed ař ɣa immet, ad t nɣen nican.
Mařa war t iggi neɛmada, maca AREBBI igga as-dd deg ufus nnes, řexdenni Necc ad ac ssecneɣ amcan mani izemmar ad yarweř.
Maca mařa yuff ḥed x wajjar nnes uca inɣa i-t s řeɣdaret, xenni ad t teksid ɣar uɛalṭar inu, maḥend ad t nɣen.
Wenni iwtin babas niɣ yemmas, ad ittwaneɣ nican.
Wenni yucaren bnadem uca izzenz i-t, niɣ ittwaf ɛad ɣares, ad ittwaneɣ nican.
Wenni i ɣa ineɛřen babas niɣ yemmas, ad ittwaneɣ nican.
Mařa iryazen mmcubbcen uca ijjen iwta wenneɣni s weẓru niɣ s řpuniyyet, uca wanita war immut, maca iwḍa di tassut,
xenni, mařa wanita ikkar ɛawed uca yuyur ɣar barra x teɣɣarct, ad yiři wenni t iwtin d amezdag. Ad as ixeǧeṣ mɣir min yareyyeḥ uca ad t yejj ad iggenfa mliḥ.
Mařa iwta ḥed ismeɣ nnes niɣ tayya nnes s weɛmud uca immut sadu ufus nnes, xenni ittxeṣṣa ad as yaɣ x tesɣart nnes nican.
Maca mařa iqqim ibedd ijj niɣ tnayen n wussan, war d as yuɣi tasɣart, minzi netta d tamenyat n nnuqart nnes i yeǧa.

Mařa iryazen mmenɣen uca wtin ict n temɣart s ddeyset uca iwḍa as-dd uɛeddis nnes, maca war iǧi ca d ayezzim, xenni netta ad ixeǧeṣ nican ijj n multa ɛlaḥsab min d as ɣa ittar weryaz n temɣart uca ad tt iwc i řquḍat.
Mařa imsar ca n uyezzim d aɛeffan, řexdenni ad tewced tudart s tudart,
tiṭṭ s tiṭṭ, tiɣmest s teɣmest, afus s ufus, aḍar s uḍar,
acmaḍ s wecmaḍ, ayezzim s uyezzim, ticti s tecti.
Mařa iřqef ḥed tiṭṭ n ismeɣ nnes niɣ tiṭṭ n tayya nnes, iḍeyyeɛ i-tt, xenni ad t yejj ad yuyur amenni zi ssibbet n tiṭṭ nnes.
Mařa s tecti ittekkes tiɣmest n ismeɣ nnes, niɣ tiɣmest n tayya nnes, xenni ad as yejj ad yuyur amenni zi ssibbet n teɣmest nnes.
Mařa afunas ibarrez aryaz niɣ tamɣart, u wanita immut, xenni ad arjmen afunas u aysum nnes war zzayes ttᵉtten. Bab n ufunas ad yiři d afurri.
Maca mařa afunas tuɣa d abarrez iḍennaḍ d fariḍennaḍ uca bab nnes tuɣa issen uca war t iḥḍi uca inɣa aryaz niɣ tamɣart, xenni ad arjmen afunas uca ɛawed ad nɣen bab nnes.
Mařa ggin xas ddeyyet, řexdenni ad iwc marra min xas ggin d ttaman n ufekki i tudart nnes,
niɣ mařa afunas ibarrez aḥenjir niɣ taḥenjirt. Ad as ggen ɛlaḥsab lfariḍa-ya.
Mařa afunas ibarrez ismeɣ niɣ tayya, ad wcen třatin ciqlu n nnuqart i sidis, uca afunas ad t arjmen.
Mařa yarzem ḥed anu niɣ mařa iɣza ḥed anu uca war t idři, uca iwḍa dayes ufunas niɣ aɣyuř,
xenni bab n wanu ad ixeǧeṣ. Ad yarr nnuqart i bab nnes uca řebhimet immuten ad tiři nnes.
Mařa afunas iyzem afunas n wajjar nnes ařami immut, řexdenni ad zzenzen afunas iddaren, ad bḍan tamenyat-a jar asen uca ad bḍan ɛawed afunas amettin.
Maca mařa issen belli afunas ibarrez iḍennaḍ d fariḍennaḍ, uca bab nnes war t iḥḍi, ad ixeǧeṣ afunas s ufunas uca afunas amettin ad yiři nnes.
Mařa yucar ḥed afunas niɣ ijjen zeg wuǧi uca iɣarṣ as niɣ izzenz i-t, xenni ad ixeǧeṣ xemsa n ifunasen x yijj n ufunas u arebɛa n wuǧi x yijjen n wuǧi.”

footnotes.text: řquḍat- niɣ ‘imezurfa’, aqa-ten d iwdan nni ɣar iǧa tussna n izerfan (ccariɛa) uca sřin i ddɛawi n iwdan maḥend ad xasen ḥekkmen.
